title: Collecting the Eggs

readiness.math: counting out a set; reading a numeral (older: different numbers for each basket)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The hens have laid lots of eggs! Some are for our kitchen, and some are for our neighbors.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hold each egg gently, and put it in a basket. Count as you go.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.prompt: Put two eggs in each basket. Count as you go: one, two.
steps.hint: Find a basket with an empty little dip, and put an egg there.

older.prompt: Each basket has a number. Put that many eggs in it: four for our kitchen, two for Mr. Tobias, three for Mrs. Ruth.
older.hint: Read the number on the basket, then count the eggs in, one at a time.

feedback.full: That basket has all its eggs. Try another basket.
feedback.all_good: Every basket has its eggs, and not one cracked!

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The eggs are collected. Thank you, hens! Good gifts come from good care.

journal_line: I collected the hens' eggs and counted them into baskets to share.
unavailable_text: The eggs are collected for today. The hens will lay more tomorrow.
